Questions.ProblemStatement: A _______________ is a basic programming construct that allows repeated execution of a fragment of source code.
_____________ is any expression that returns a Boolean result – true or false.
Questions.Hint: It checks if something is true or false.

Questions.ProblemStatement: In 'for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)', what is the increment part?
Questions.Hint: It's the part that happens at the end of every loop.

Questions.ProblemStatement: In 'for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)', what is the initialization part?
Questions.Hint: It sets the starting value of the counter.

Questions.ProblemStatement: The ______________ are programming constructs consisting of several loops located into each other.
Questions.Hint: Like a box inside another box.

Questions.ProblemStatement: ______________ is the building block of object-oriented programming. It combines related code together and makes program easier.
Questions.Hint: A function that belongs to a class.
